verdict.rationale: Elicit's first-party docs describe Alerts that keep researchers up to date on new research about chosen topics. Instant email alerts fire whenever a new relevant paper is found, and results can be added to the Library. Routines go further, filtering on criteria and writing summaries of what they find. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts reliably surface relevant new papers, and detail on alert configuration (query setup, frequency options).
